VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer places the deny check in `ServerManager::execute`, but it also describes a chain of other gates (anti-spiral block, schema, MCP authorization, tier, duplicate check, approval). It does not conclude that the deny list is the only thing that blocks execution.
